headline: Accepted retirement of Laurie Saia and approved school meal price increases for 2026-2027.
summary: The board accepted gifts, meeting minutes, and the retirement of English teacher Laurie Saia effective July 31, 2026. It approved a schedule of meetings for February 2027 through January 2028 and new school breakfast and lunch prices for 2026-2027. A resident raised safety concerns about PTO volunteer background checks and resource officers during public comment.
decisions: Unanimous approval to accept Items 7.1-7.4 on the Consent Agenda, including June 22 and June 25, 2026 special meeting minutes, a $25,000.00 in-kind gift from Masonicare Health Center, and a $1,500.00 monetary gift from Trail of Terror LLC.
Unanimous approval to go into Executive Session under Connecticut General Statutes Section 1-200(6)(A) to discuss acceptance of retirement(s) at 6:39 p.m.
Unanimous approval to amend the agenda to add Public Comment back in after the Operations Committee Agenda Item 14.
Unanimous approval to accept the retirement of Laurie Saia effective July 31, 2026.
Unanimous approval of the Board of Education Schedule of Meetings for February 2027 - January 2028.
Unanimous approval of school breakfast and lunch prices for Elementary, Middle, High School students and Adults, set at 10 cents for Breakfast, 35 cents for Lunch, and 85 cents for Adults.

Mr.  Hathaway  explained  the  School  Year  2026-2027  Meal  Price  Increase  Proposal.   The  Wallingford  Schools  Food  service  operations  is  proposing  a  .35  cent  increase  in  the  price  of  Lunch  for  the  2026-2027  school  year.  We  are  also  proposing  a  .10  increase  in  breakfast  pricing.  Even  though  breakfast  is  free  for  all  during  the  school  year  2026-2027  legislation  has  not  passed  to  determine  if  it  will  remain  free  beyond  this  upcoming  school  year.
